findings.issue: אֵל is a common noun (HNcmsa), not a proper name; "El" leaves the lemma untranslated instead of Spanish.
עֶלְיוֹן is an adjective (HAamsa), not a proper noun; "Elyón" transliterates and capitalizes it as a name.
נֹפֵל is a qal active participle (falling); "caído" is a resultative past participle (fallen) and changes stem force.
Qal imperfect 3ms is rendered as present "contempla", selecting one time the imperfect leaves open.

notes: Remaining tokens match: oráculo, oyente, dichos, y conocedor, conocimiento, visión, Shadai, y descubierto, ojos.
